keyElementSelectors.description:
Selectors for detecting whether the page has been loaded. The page is assumed to be loaded when all the selectors
exists.

baseUrl.description:
The base url of the page to load, which is usually the vanity url.
Prepending this to the {@link path} is our {@link testUrl}.

path.description:
The path of the page to load (i.e. movie/movies).
Appending this to the {@link baseUrl} creates the {@link testUrl}.

testUrl.description: The url of the page to load. Either this or {@link testPage} is required.

maxExecuteAsyncScriptRetry.description:
Maximum number of time `executeAsyncScript` should be retried.
This is necessary to fix "document unloaded while waiting for result" error in chromium.

testPage.description: A test page to load. Either this or {@link testUrl} is required.

pollingIntervalMilliseconds.description: The interval for `setTimeout()` for the browser script that generates the performance results.

timeoutSeconds.description:
The maximum amount of time to wait for the results. When this time elapses, any results
that have been generated will be returned.

customMetricNames.description: The chosen performance metrics that we wish to persist as {@link MaximGunStat}s.
